mapper.select: SELECT GAME_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IMAGE_PATH, LINK_URL, CATEGORY, REG_DATE FROM GAMES WHERE CATEGORY = #{param1} ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC LIMIT #{param2} OFFSET 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GAMES (GAME_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IMAGE_PATH, LINK_URL, CATEGORY, REG_DATE) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{imagePath}, #{linkUrl}, #{category}, NOW())
